title: Design System & Core Utilities

files_created.description: Complete design system CSS variables including spacing scale, layout dimensions, typography, status colors, priority colors, safety levels, role-based colors, semantic colors, border radius, shadows, transitions, z-index layers, and RTL/LTR logical properties
Utility function for merging Tailwind CSS classes with clsx and tailwind-merge
TypeScript enums for UserRole, AssetStatus, WorkOrderStatus, Priority, SafetyLevel, TicketStatus, CycleStatus, NotificationType, PermissionAction, and ResourceType
Permission system with role hierarchy, default permissions matrix, and helper functions (hasPermission, hasAllPermissions, hasAnyPermission, getRolePermissions, isRoleAtLeast, isRoleHigherThan)
Button component with variants (primary, secondary, outline, ghost, danger, success), sizes (sm, md, lg), loading state, icon support, and fullWidth option
Input component with label, error states, helper text, left/right icons, full accessibility support (aria-invalid, aria-describedby)
Secure password input with show/hide toggle, built-in Button for toggle, accessibility features
Card container with padding options, hoverable state, plus CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter sub-components
Badge component with multiple variants (success, warning, error, info, neutral, priority levels), size options, icon support, plus helper functions for status/priority mapping
Modal dialog with overlay click close, escape key handling, body scroll prevention, multiple sizes, header/footer slots, plus ModalHeader, ModalBody, ModalFooter sub-components
Barrel export file for all UI components

css_variables.spacing_scale: 12 steps (space-1 to space-24) based on 4px grid
css_variables.typography: font families (Inter, JetBrains Mono), 7 font sizes, 4 font weights, 3 line heights
css_variables.status_colors: 5 states (success, warning, error, info, neutral) with light/main/dark variants
css_variables.priority_colors: 4 levels (critical, high, medium, low) with light/main/dark variants
css_variables.safety_colors: 4 levels (safe, caution, warning, danger) with light/main/dark variants

design_system_features.dark_mode: Basic dark mode CSS variable overrides defined

features: Tailwind CSS styling with cn() utility

utilities_summary.cn: Class name merger using clsx and tailwind-merge
utilities_summary.constants: 10 enums for type-safe values across the application
utilities_summary.permissions: Complete RBAC system with 6 roles, 6 actions, 8 resource types

notes: All components use forwardRef where appropriate for proper React ref handling
SecureInput includes Eye/EyeOff icons from lucide-react for password visibility toggle
Badge includes helper functions to map status/priority strings to appropriate variants
Modal prevents body scroll when open and handles escape key automatically
All form inputs include proper ARIA attributes for accessibility
CSS uses logical properties (margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end) for RTL support
recommendations: Consider adding a Storybook setup in Piece 3 or 4 for component documentation and testing
Add more comprehensive form validation utilities for Piece 3 (Auth subsystem)
Consider creating a Toast/Notification component early as it will be needed for auth feedback
The permission system could be extended with custom permission hooks for easier component-level checks
Consider adding data-testid attributes to components for easier E2E testing setup later
May want to add a Spinner/Loader standalone component for reuse beyond Button loading state
